headline: Liquor license transfer for Santo Domingo Liquors and a complaint against YH Enterprise INC DBA Eleven Kitchen & Bar.
summary: The board will review a new liquor license transfer application for Santo Domingo Liquors, a tabled complaint about Eleven Kitchen & Bar, and a tabled liquor license transfer for Envy Lounge.
items: New Business - LICENSE #LL26-000041 - Santo Domingo Liquors applying to transfer a Liquor License to Don Pedro Liquors Inc. with a Pledge of Collateral (License/Stock) and Pledge of Inventory at 419 Hampshire St. ABCC application attached. Representing: Attorney Corrigan, Pedro A Beato/ Barbara Correia

Complaint tabled on October 07, 2026 - YH Enterprise INC DBA Eleven Kitchen & Bar. Complaint regarding New Ownership, management, Liquor License, and outdoor dining arrangements. See attached report by Commissioner Laird. Representing: Yoel Herrera

Tabled on 9/23/2026 - LICENSE #LL26-000039 - Father & Son DBA Envy Lounge applying to transfer their existent Liquor License to Kathan LLC DBA Rumba Bar & Lounge. Representing: Attorney Brian Corrigan/ Marisol Rodriguez
Next Licensing Board meeting will be held on November 11, 2026, at 5:30pm
location: DPW Conference Room 203, City Hall, 200 Common Street, Lawrence, MA 01840
